title: All Core Devs - Execution (ACDE) #245, September 10, 2026
agendaMarkdown:
- Glamsterdam
  - proposal to add [EIP-8253](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8253) to Glamsterdam
	- see [comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2211#issuecomment-5572726556) by @danceratopz and [writeup](https://gist.github.com/jochem-brouwer/72b97452ba440da909e5da5bdf876817) by @jochem-brouwer
- Hegotá
  - proposal to PFI [EIP-8411](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12299), to be discussed on ACDC next week
    - see [comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2211#issuecomment-5601739597) by @kamilsa for context
  - [EIP-8141](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8141) headliner decision
  - EL EIPs not part of the client ranking
    - already SFI'd
      - [EIP-8141](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8141): Frame Transaction
    - meta EIP, no separate inclusion decision
      - [EIP-8173](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8173): Foundations of EVM Control Flow
    - cross-layer, to be discussed & decided on ACDC
      - [EIP-8146](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8146): Block Access List Sidecars
      - [EIP-8237](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8237): Independent CL/EL Sync
    - withdrawn by the proposer
      - [EIP-7686](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7686): Linear EVM memory limits
      - [EIP-7971](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7971): Hard Limits for Transient Storage
      - [EIP-7973](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7973): Warm Account Write Metering
    - no champion
      - [EIP-7609](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7609): Decrease base cost of TLOAD/TSTORE
      - [EIP-8058](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8058): Contract Bytecode Deduplication Discount
      - [EIP-8268](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8268): Storage Roots in Block Access Lists
    - status open, placeholder for an ephemeral-contract solution, to be clarified on this call
      - [EIP-8360](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12073): TCREATE Opcode
        - see [comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2211#issuecomment-5618394952) by @milonite
  - first Hegota scoping pass using the [forkcast client rankings aggregation](https://forkcast.org/upgrade/hegota/client-priority/?layer=EL&team=Besu%2CErigon%2CEthrex%2CGeth%2CNethermind%2CReth&only=1&group=category)
    - see [comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2211#issuecomment-5618928305) by @anderselowsson regarding [EIP-8372](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8372)
